title: FrozenSell
description: The best sell gui plugin inspired by DonutSMP sell
body:
# 💸 FrozenSell — Sell Your Items, The Smart Way

FrozenSell is a sleek, all-in-one item-selling plugin. Drop your items in, watch your balance grow, and track every coin you've ever earned — all from one clean GUI. No clunky `/sell hand` spam, no guessing prices. 🧊

---

## 🛒 The Sell GUI

Type **`/sell`** to open the main selling menu. Just toss your items into the grid — anything sellable turns into instant cash. 💰

When you close the menu after selling, you'll see a quick action-bar pop-up showing exactly what you earned:

> **+15.7K** 🟢

...paired with a satisfying *pling* sound effect, so you always know a sale went through. 🔔

### 🧭 Quick-Access Buttons
Right inside the Sell GUI, three handy buttons give you instant access to everything else the plugin offers — no extra commands needed:

- 📖 **Sell History** — click the book & quill to pull up a complete log of everything you've ever sold
- 🧭 **Sell Stats** — the compass shows your lifetime money made and total items sold, right in the lore
- 🪣 **Items Worth** — click the hopper to browse the full price list for every sellable item

---

## 📜 Sell History — `/sellhistory`

Curious what you've sold over time? Your full sell history is tracked forever and displayed in a clean, paginated menu — flip through page after page if you're a serial seller. 📚➡️📚➡️📚

---

## 💲 Item Worth — `/worth`

Want to know what something's worth before you sell it?

- **`/worth`** — opens a browsable GUI of every item and its price 🗂️
- **`/worth <item>`** — check the price of any specific item 🔍
- **`/worth hand`** — instantly check the price of whatever you're holding ✋

---

## 👁️ Worth Lore Toggle — `/worthtoggle`

Want item prices to show up right on the item's tooltip while you're playing? Toggle it on or off anytime with **`/worthtoggle`** — fully optional, fully your call. ✨

---

## 🛠️ For Admins

- **`/setworth <item|hand> <price> [category]`** — set or update the price of any item, or just price whatever's in your hand 🧑‍🔧
- **`/sell reload`** — reload the plugin's configs without restarting the server ♻️

---

## ⌨️ Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/sell` (alias: `/sellgui`) | Opens the main Sell GUI 🛒 |
| `/sell help` | Shows the help menu ❓ |
| `/sell reload` | Reloads the plugin's configs ♻️ (admin) |
| `/worth` | Opens the Items Worth GUI 🗂️ |
| `/worth <item>` | Check the price of a specific item 🔍 |
| `/worth hand` | Check the price of the item in your hand ✋ |
| `/worthtoggle` | Toggle item-price lore on tooltips 👁️ |
| `/sellhistory` | View your paginated sell history 📜 |
| `/setworth <item\|hand> <price> [category]` | Set or update an item's price 🧑‍🔧 (admin) |

---

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission | Grants Access To | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `frozensell.use` | `/sell` | ✅ Everyone |
| `frozensell.worth` | `/worth`, `/worthtoggle` | ✅ Everyone |
| `frozensell.history` | `/sellhistory` | ✅ Everyone |
| `frozensell.setworth` | `/setworth` | 🛡️ OP only |
| `frozensell.reload` | `/sell reload` | 🛡️ OP only |
| `frozensell.admin` | All of the above (master permission) | 🛡️ OP only |

---

## ⚙️ Compatibility

✅ Paper, Purpur & **Folia** supported
✅ Minecraft **1.21 → 1.21.11**
✅ Works with Vault economy (or FrozenVault)

---

## 👤 Author

Built with ❄️ by **DrFrozenXD**, the developer behind **FrozenStudio**.
Got feedback, bug reports, or feature ideas? Reach out — this plugin is actively maintained and updated. 🚀

---

### TL;DR
Open `/sell`, dump your junk, get paid, watch the action bar light up. Check your stats, history, and prices without ever leaving the GUI. That's FrozenSell. 🧊💵
